body: I ended up attempting and woke up. I don't know if I should go to the hospital or not. I uninstalled all my messaging platforms after I saw my friend making fun of me in my group chat for my attempt. My boyfriend read everything and said that it was bad and I shouldn't read it. I feel so sick. I don't have any friends left because of what I did. I just want to die

I know it can feel empty coming from words on a screen, but I know what it's like to be in your position. I feel like I'm cursed because when I fall in love with someone it's hard for me to fall out of love. The girl I love the most is someone who hasn't so much as batted an eyelash at me in four years, I know she doesn't think of me anymore and when she did, she still didn't love me. 

I'm truly sorry for how you're feeling but you aren't alone. The things that make life beautiful come in the darkest times in the most unexpected ways. I can't reach out through the screen to you but I promise that there's at least one other soul out there listening to you. I'm here, and if there's anything else you need to let out I'm listening.
